Watchfire Flare.name: Watchfire Flare
Watchfire Flare.description: The user lobs a ball of flame high overhead, where it bursts into a slow-falling flare that burns for a few minutes. It lights the whole area, reveals anyone hiding in the dark and marks the spot for responders; anyone facing the burst is dazzled and cannot aim or track the user until the end of their next turn. Strain: moderate.
